comment: Hard class but caring and lots of content.

Chan Laoshi is a great Mandarin teacher; I'm writing this on behalf of both 301 & 302 and they're both courses I would recommend to those who ACTUALLY want to get serious about Chinese learning for a major or minor. Be prepared for consistent class participation, memorized presentations, and routine quizzes/exams -- but overall not too hard.
Great teacher. Very accessible outside of class, would help you one on one. A lot of reading and film watching. The paper are not easy but she allows rewrites and she gives great feedback.

Very passionate and cares about her students. Class is focused on speaking so be prepared to get cold-called. Homework ramps up near the end, but if you need an extension and explain to her she is understanding. Tests can be rough if you aren't ready for listening, so just make sure you know the grammar and vocab well and review previous units.
Very lively personality and understanding if you need extra time as long as you explain the circumstances to her. Pop quizzes pretty much every day, ~10 or less characters.

Her class consists of vocab quizzes (every class), 1-2x homework assignments/week, 3ish chapter quizzes, 2 short papers, a midterm, & a final. She is typically good about outlining expectations but you have to learn her grading style as you go. I recommend getting to know her a bit outside of class. Helpful w study abroad if you're interested

Really great professor. Classes can drag sometimes, but just push through and focus and you'll be fine on tests. If you reach out for help if you're struggling you will be gladShe really cares that her students understand the material. One of the best professors I've ever had, not just for Chinese.

Best Chinese teacher I've ever had. If you pay attention and somewhat try on the HW you're already guaranteed to do well. She's so nice and so good at teaching. Wish she could teach me every Chinese class from now on.
Dr. Chan is a great professor. She is so happy to be teaching and makes the class interesting with great videos to help learn the material. She is one of the best Chinese Professors I have had.

I don't know why Chan laoshi has such bad reviews. I think her class is fairly strait forward and easy so long as you do her hw and show up to class. She is really patient and really willing to work with the students. I would definitely take her again.

Dr. Chan is unique. She is very energetic, but does not seem interested in her students' concerns. She doesn't seem to understand that students don't understand the material sometimes because of her, not because we don't work hard. There is A LOT of homework and the tests are very hard. I will take her again, but only because there's no one else.
She can definitely get boring at times, but if you want an easy class to put minimal effort into this it. Do the readings, participate in class, and you can expect a B at least.

Sees her own viewpoint as paramount. Ignores students' different opinions styles and experiences, shuts them down when they try to express themselves. Tries to be a "tough" professor, but fails as she is not intelligent enough to keep up with her students. holds grudges if you "beat her" during an in-class discussion.
